title: Lattice Promotes Sophie Roberts to Chief Product and Technology Officer to Accelerate Its People + AI Platform
summary: Lattice today announced the promotion of Sophie Roberts to Chief Product and Technology Officer from her previous role as SVP of Engineering. In her expanded role, Sophie will oversee the company’s Engineering, Product, and Design teams. — Sep 02, 2026
body_markdown:
Lattice today announced the promotion of Sophie Roberts to Chief Product and Technology Officer from her previous role as SVP of Engineering. In her expanded role, Sophie will oversee the company’s Engineering, Product, and Design teams.


As Lattice advances continuous, AI-native performance, Sophie’s promotion bolsters the company’s commitment to delivering trusted workforce intelligence that connects People + AI strategy to measurable business outcomes.


Sarah Franklin, CEO of Lattice, comments:


“Sophie has consistently embodied exceptional leadership and operational rigor within our engineering organization since joining Lattice, elevating how we build and deliver. She brings a combination of technical depth, thoughtful judgment, and a deep commitment to our customers. As we move into the next phase of our People + AI vision, her expanded role fuels our mission to make work more meaningful.”


Sophie Roberts, Chief Product and Technology Officer, Lattice, says:


“After two decades working in technology at some of the world’s most successful companies, I’ve seen a consistent truth: the highest-performing organizations are those that enable their people to thrive. Our customers are entering a profound transformation in how people and AI work together, and I’m excited to continue supporting the Lattice team as we help them navigate this shift—unlocking continuous performance at scale for everyone.”
